service.method: SELECT * FROM (SELECT NOTICE_NUMBER ,SUBJECT ,COMPANY_CODE ,DEPT_TYPE ,ATTACH_NO ,ADD_USER_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM SUSMT WHERE SUSMT.HOUSE_CODE=SNOTE.HOUSE_CODE AND USER_ID = SNOTE.ADD_USER_ID) ADD_USER_NAME ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,CHANGE_USER_ID ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,DEL_FLAG ,NOTE_TYPE ,GONGJI_GUBUN ,GETCODETEXT(HOUSE_CODE,'AD011', GONGJI_GUBUN, ${session.LANGUAGE}) GONGJI_GUBUN_TEXT ,PUBLISH_FLAG ,GETCODETEXT(HOUSE_CODE,'AD013', PUBLISH_FLAG, ${session.LANGUAGE}) PUBLISH_FLAG_TEXT ,PUBLISH_FROM_DATE ,PUBLISH_TO_DATE ,VIEW_COUNT ,POPUP_LOCATION FROM SNOTE WHERE nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND PUBLISH_FLAG = 'Y' AND NOTE_TYPE = 'N' AND GONGJI_GUBUN in (${USER_TYPE}, 'A') AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND PUBLISH_FROM_DATE <= ${current.DATE} AND PUBLISH_TO_DATE >= ${current.DATE} ) A WHERE ( GONGJI_GUBUN_TEXT = $S{F_KEYWORD} OR PUBLISH_FLAG_TEXT = $S{F_KEYWORD} OR ADD_USER_NAME like $S{F_KEYWORD} OR NOTICE_NUMBER like $S{F_KEYWORD} OR SUBJECT like $S{F_KEYWORD} AND 1=1 ) ORDER BY NOTICE_NUMBER DESC
SELECT NOTICE_SEQ ,CONTENT FROM SNOTD WHERE NOTICE_NUMBER = ${NOTICE_NUMBER} AND NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY CAST( NOTICE_SEQ AS NUMBER )

SELECT NOTICE_NUMBER , SUBJECT FROM SNOTE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND POPUP_LOCATION = $S{POPUP_LOCATION} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND PUBLISH_FLAG = 'Y' AND GONGJI_GUBUN in ( $S{session.USER_TYPE}, 'A') AND ( PUBLISH_FROM_DATE <= ${current.DATE} AND PUBLISH_TO_DATE >= ${current.DATE} AND 1=1 ) ORDER BY NOTICE_NUMBER DESC
